SELECT u.id, u.collateral_type_id, u.value_of_collateral, u.quality, u.status, u.is_del, u.operator_id, u.user_name, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.parameters, u.update_user_id, u.update_user_name, d.collateral_type_value as collateralTypeValue, d.collateral_type as collateralType FROM biz_ware_house u LEFT JOIN dic_collateral_type d ON u.collateral_type_id = d.id
AND d.collateral_type like concat('%', #{query.collateralType}, '%')
AND d.collateral_type_value like concat('%', #{query.collateralTypeValue}, '%')
AND u.user_name like concat('%', #{query.userName}, '%')
AND u.status = #{query.status}
ORDER BY u.create_time DESC

SELECT u.id, u.collateral_type_id, u.value_of_collateral, u.quality, u.status, u.is_del, u.operator_id, u.user_name, u.create_time, u.update_time, u.parameters, u.update_user_id, u.update_user_name, d.collateral_type_value as collateralTypeValue, d.collateral_type as collateralType FROM biz_ware_house u LEFT JOIN dic_collateral_type d ON u.collateral_type_id = d.id
AND u.id = #{id}
